newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's 1996 inflation put at below four pct.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's 1996 inflation put at below four pct.

text.p: Tunisia's inflation as measured by the consumer price index (CPI) is expected to be below four percent for the whole of 1996, Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali said on Saturday.
"We expect that the indice's increase for 1996 will stay below four percent," Ben Ali said in a speech at parliament.

The CPI rose 0.2 percent in November compared to October, and at an average rate of 3.8 percent during the first eleven months of 1996 compared with the same period in 1995, official figures showed earlier this month.
